road.name: Downey Creek Trailhead via Suiattle River Road (FR 26)
road.status: Suiattle River Road (FR 26) suffered major flood/washout damage and is closed to vehicles at approximately milepost 4.5 under a closure order in effect April 2, 2026 through January 1, 2028. The Downey Creek Trail itself is also closed August 15 through December 31, 2026 under the Forest Service's Miner's Fire closure order. Vehicle access to the historic trailhead is not possible while the road order stands.
road.driveNote: Normally about 2.5-3 hours from Seattle via Darrington and the Suiattle River Road when fully open; while the road closure order (April 2, 2026 through January 1, 2028) stands, it requires walking or biking the closed road from the MP 4.5 closure gate, adding several miles to the approach.
